notes.title: Content Update Coming on Halloween!
notes.content:
Greetings Crania Games followers!
We will release the new content update on Halloween with a discount! This update will include a new game mode that contains 6 new characters and a new map! Keep following us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39499679/79f85f775b6252cd3a61f7bccaab78695f1fd32e.png[/img]
Join us on Discord and be a part of development!

notes.title: Content Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Crania Games followers,

After the major update which we released last week, we started to prepare new content update. It is coming soon with lots of changes and new game mode. Our all content updates will include specific map, killer and victims with specific game mechanics.

We are also preparing a ranked matchmaking system and skill tree / level up system.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39499679/6bc8d0944e26e754441d7c82c30e17167b81b383.png[/img]
Join us on Discord and be a part of development!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39499679/3a276346db5462e0d261b2fadbede63fd252f557.png[/img]
